file.intro: Choose an Excel (xlsx, xls, ods) or CSV file. Column titles can be in Arabic, French or English. The template shows the expected columns.
file.name: File

mapping.intro: Say what each column of the file holds. Fields followed by * are required.
mapping.headerRowHelp: Found automatically. The rows above it are ignored.

policies.sync: Make the list match the file

policyHelp.create_only: Only new records are created. A row matching an existing record is skipped and reported.
policyHelp.upsert: New records are created, existing ones are updated with the file's values.
policyHelp.sync: Like “Create and update”, then the products that are not in the file are archived (never deleted).

mapping.posting: Each row adds an opening entry. Nothing is changed or deleted, and the import can be undone the same day.
mapping.locationHelp: Receives the rows of the file that have no location column.
mapping.countNone: No stock count is open. Start one in Stock › Stock counts.

check.intro: The check reads the whole file and saves nothing.
check.changed: The columns changed since the check. Check the file again.
check.none: No problems: the file is ready to import.
check.truncated: Only the first problems are listed. Fix them, then check the file again.
check.stockKept: Products missing from the file kept for their stock (not archived): {{n}}. Bring their stock to zero to be able to archive them.
check.stockKeptMore: And others: see the stock levels.

apply.needsCheck: Check the file with these columns before importing.
apply.ready: Refused rows will not be imported.

done.failed: The import stopped before the end. The rows already imported are kept; you can undo this import.
done.undoBody: Records created by the import will be archived, changed records get their previous values back, and opening balances are cancelled.

problems.required: This column is required and the cell is empty.
problems.too_many_decimals: Too many digits after the decimal separator.
problems.ambiguous_separator: Ambiguous separator: decimal or thousands? Write 1234.50 with no thousands separator.
problems.negative: A negative value is not allowed here.
problems.choice_invalid: Unknown value: use one of the values listed in the help sheet.
problems.phone_invalid: Not a valid Algerian phone number.
problems.not_found: No product, customer or supplier matches this row.
problems.duplicate_in_file: This row repeats an earlier row of the file.
problems.barcode_taken: This barcode already belongs to another product.
problems.reference_taken: This reference already belongs to another product.
problems.phone_taken: This phone number already belongs to another customer.
problems.opening_already_set: The opening balance is already set.
